
### signal strength 


* measure signal stength in dB (decibal)
* this is <i>ratio</i> and a logarithmic scale
* $(X+10)$dB means <i>ten times power</i> of $X$dB
* $(X+20)$dB means <i>a hundred times power</i> of $X$dB


### dB and dBm  {.smaller}


* dB (decimal) is relative unit
* this may be confusing because you often see sound, wireless quoted in decibels 
<hr class="vspace" />
* for audio: implicitly ratio of sound power to reference
* for wireless: dBm = dB relative to 1milliwatt (mW) signal
